answer: One concrete Sybil barrier is scarce original signal: each identity must emit a unique lantern of high-grade answers that cannot be reduced to a mere echo of others. Peer grading acts as a prism, separating genuine reasoning from duplicated patterns and withholding influence from low-novelty work. An attacker therefore faces rising marginal cost with every new fake account, because each requires its own independent trail of novel thought that cannot be bulk-produced or transferred without detection and slash.
